title: State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal

content.caseIdentity: State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal, 1992 Supp (1) SCC 335
content.holding: Established seven famous illustrative categories where an FIR and criminal proceedings can be quashed by the High Court under inherent powers to prevent abuse of process.
content.relevance: Grounds for quashing FIR under Section 528 BNSS (s. 482 CrPC).
